Description: As a new user, I want to register with my email and password so that I can access the system. Acceptance Criteria: Password strength validation, email verification link dispatched.

As a frontend client, I want a secure REST API endpoint /api/auth/login with JWT token issuance so that sessions are authenticated. Acceptance Criteria: 200 OK with token on valid credentials, 401 Unauthorized on failure.
As an authenticated user, I want a responsive landing dashboard with navigation links to tasks and profile. Acceptance Criteria: Fully responsive layout for mobile and desktop.
Execute automated integration tests and security boundary tests (SQLi, brute-force throttling) for authentication.
Containerize application with Docker and deploy to staging environment with health check validation.
